scenario: Guest CPU on vm-worker-08 saturates (41% -> 98%) from 10:00 UTC; redis-cart-0, which runs on that VM, then logs slow commands, client timeouts, and refused connections from 10:02 UTC.

expected_root_cause.summary: CPU saturation on VM vm-worker-08 starved the Redis pod running on it.

expected_symptom.summary: Redis latency, client timeouts, and refused connections.
